purpose: Fortified siege tactical-gate diagnostic and positive wall-breach/capture control

plannerBoundary.interpretation: The legal city-wall shot is not unavailable; the ordinary ranker places it tenth because Threats.at estimates 80 damage from the fortified enemy city at the catapult position. Standby/retreat scores -18, while the wall shot is penalised to -60.8. The same move request succeeds through Actions.apply.

oneCatapultTacticalHook.hook: siegeAttackHook: re-rank only original choices with forecast.wallDamage > 0
oneCatapultTacticalHook.finding: Forcing one legal siege shot exposes the real counterfire tradeoff: the city strikes and kills the lone catapult before repeated wall damage can accumulate; wallHP regenerates to 100.

fortifiedCapturePositiveControl.hook: same siegeAttackHook; all choices remain live legal Actions.apply requests
fortifiedCapturePositiveControl.finding: A reasonable multi-siege group can breach a 100-wall-HP city in two legal rounds and capture on round 3 despite two defensive city strikes. This is a controlled competence positive, not a full-game balance estimate; it shows the single-siege quota/exposure is materially different from an actual siege-group capability.

limitations: The fortified positive control intentionally supplies three ordinary catapults and a melee escort; it is labelled scenario budget, not a resource-free full-game claim.
No unit costs, combat stats, walls, movement or action rules were changed.
The tactical hook changes only ranking among existing legal forecasts and is not installed live AI.
